newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ometraco to issue rights for acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Ometraco to issue rights for acquisitions.

text.p: Indonesian property firm PT Ometraco Realty announced on Monday a 356.4 billion rupiah rights issue, with the proceeds being partly used to acquire property firms PT Angkasa Interland and PT Panen Lestari Basuki.
Ometraco planned to buy a 95 percent stake in Angkasa worth 95 billion rupiah and a 95 percent stake worth 128.25 billion rupiah in Panen Lestari, it said in a statement.
Ometraco said it would seek shareholder approval for the planned acquisitions and rights issue at a meeting scheduled for November 29.
The statement did not give further details.
